answer: The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, converted to a slow vesting stream, rewards vest against future work. What survives to the island is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the mesa of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the pigment re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
